title: Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.19542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy sa

translated_title: Func-JEPA：将函数的Sobolev空间学习为潜在向量
translated_abstract: 在视觉和语言领域，预训练一次编码器并在多个任务中重用是一种广泛采用的方法。然而，神经符号数学仍然为每个任务训练专用的序列到序列模型，因此没有共享的函数表示。在这项工作中，我们提出了函数联合嵌入预测架构（Func-JEPA，简称f-JEPA）：一个数学函数的编码器，在其符号形式上进行预训练，其潜在空间模仿Sobolev空间H^1，并且微分在该空间中是一个学习到的潜在算子。潜在向量的范数从函数中精确计算，而其方向则通过学习来匹配Sobolev角度。冻结的编码器随后被轻量级模块重用，用于从样本中进行解码、组合、积分和回归。该表示和四个下游任务在预训练分布之内和之外都进行了评估。f-JEPA能够从带噪声的样本中恢复精确的公式……
tldr: 提出Func-JEPA，一个在函数符号形式上预训练的数学函数编码器，其潜在空间模仿Sobolev空间H^1并将微分建模为可学习的潜在算子，冻结编码器可被轻量级模块重用于解码、组合、积分和回归等多种下游任务。
